summary: The prepared main already contains the issue's EOS-bounded comparison. Upstream commit a26735e43e7f33b5c929d2ad24556d4da2be4151 (merged in PR #34166) added _truncate_at_eos and compares solo and batched streams only through the first EOS. No additional source correction was justified; this PR records verification evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact reported test module collected; both tests skipped because mlx and mlx_lm require Apple Silicon and are unavailable on this Linux gfx950 host.
Executed the checked-out _truncate_at_eos helper against five independent boundaries and a failing-before/passing-after post-EOS divergence fixture.
Confirmed one assigned AMD Instinct MI350X and successful ROCm tensor execution; this does not execute or validate Apple MLX.

gpu_execution_evidence: Issue-specific MLX GPU execution was not possible: MLX is Apple Silicon/Metal-only. The assigned gfx950 (AMD Instinct MI350X) was detected and operational through ROCm, but that unrelated smoke is not counted as issue-path GPU execution.
remaining_limitations: The Qwen1.5-MoE MLX model test and original Apple Silicon numerical reproduction could not run on the assigned Linux gfx950 host because mlx and mlx_lm are unavailable and Metal hardware is required.
No claim is made about the distinct full-horizon assertion in test/registered/mlx/models_e2e/test_gpt_oss_mlx_correctness.py; that different gpt-oss sliding-window path remains unverified here.
No native code was changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
